name: Wangdeng Youye
source:
A tall Illuminator whose face is difficult to see due to the hood she wears. She resides near Earthcaress Beacon in the forest.

[spoiler]Lura's personality is actually gentler than what her appearance suggests. She has a loyal Darkritter named "Lamp Spirit" living inside her lantern.

Some Illuminators say that her Darkriters manipulation ability is actually a terrible disease… but she never gave up on herself. She persists in finding a way for Illuminators and Darkritters to coexist.[/spoiler]
